title: Trip Protection Policy Period, Free Look Days and Premium Refund Percentages
content:
On every Trip Protection plan, trip cancellation cover starts the day after purchase, every other benefit starts on the check-in date, and coverage ends on the stay's check-out date. The plans differ in the length of their free-look period; the percentage of the premium refunded when a policy is voided, and on a cancellation after the free look, is the same on all six.

## Terms by plan

| Plan | Free-look period (calendar days after purchase) | Premium refunded when the policy is voided (percent) | Premium refunded on a cancellation after the free look (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Cancellation Only | 10 | 100.00 | 0.00 |
| Trip Protection Essential | 10 | 100.00 | 0.00 |
| Trip Protection Standard | 10 | 100.00 | 0.00 |
| Trip Protection Plus | 14 | 100.00 | 0.00 |
| Trip Protection Premier | 14 | 100.00 | 0.00 |
| Trip Protection Premier CFAR | 14 | 100.00 | 0.00 |

## Coverage period, every plan

| Benefit | Coverage starts | Coverage ends |
|---|---|---|
| Trip cancellation | the day after purchase | the stay's check-out date |
| Every other benefit | the check-in date | the stay's check-out date |

## Notes

- The free-look period is the number of calendar days after purchase during which the guest may cancel for a full refund: 10 days on Trip Cancellation Only, Trip Protection Essential and Trip Protection Standard, and 14 days on Trip Protection Plus, Trip Protection Premier and Trip Protection Premier CFAR.
- On every plan a voided policy has 100.00 percent of its premium refunded, and a cancellation after the free look refunds 0.00 percent of the premium.
- Cancellation cover starts the day after purchase. On hypothetical dates, a plan bought on 3 March gives cancellation cover from 4 March; for a stay checking in on 20 March, travel delay, baggage, medical and the other benefits start on 20 March. Both end on the stay's check-out date.
